summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state (_loop, _thread_id) initialized in the constructor and set/cleared in the run_app entry coroutine's try/finally. Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with 9 tests; all 9 pass when run against this repo's src (PYTHONPATH set to src). Caveat: the venv imports textual from the base task directory, so PYTHONPATH was required. Several existing modules (test_call_later, test_unmount, test_message_pump, test_screens) fail with "async def functions are not natively supported", which appears to be an environment issue, not verified by stashing. Nothing committed. A stray pytest run collected names from another run directory (run-07); I did not inspect or modify it.
